text:
Lina (CSM): Heads-up  Borealis QBR in 6 days. We just saw a sharp change in their cost profile after the new "smart-search" rollout — embeddings + short-form chat combos. Need a one-slide QBR summary + concrete asks (quota/credits/enablement).
Mason (FinOps): 7d vs baseline: +142% spend. If this persists, month goes from ~$12.6k -> ~$30.6k. I'll run a 30d sensitivity and a mitigated scenario.
quota-bot: Alert: account borealis-prod crossed soft threshold (daily spend 5.2k) at 2026-05-07T13:22Z.
Gabe (Solutions Eng): Probable drivers: 1) per-interaction embeddings for UI + gen for replies, 2) no batching, 3) new rerank path calling full-context LLM. Low-effort fixes: batch embeddings, quantize emb model (8-bit), and route cheap flows to emb-small.
Priya (Onboarding PM): I'll schedule a 30m enablement with their engs. Can we make a short pre-meeting checklist? Ask: top queries, sample 2k calls, recent deploy diff, and which flows require low-latency vs batch.
Lina (CSM): Please ask them to share the sample logs before the session. Mason/Gabe  give 2-3 plays with estimated savings for the slide. Also we should propose a small credit to smooth the transition.
Mason (FinOps): Draft plays: A) switch non-critical flows to emb-small -> est -35% on embedding spend for those flows; B) batching + client-side bundling -> est -20-40%; C) temporary soft cap = avg*1.25, hard cap = avg*2. I'll model a credit ask to cover 5 days at 50% of expected overrun.
Gabe (Solutions Eng): Tech plays: 1) Trial quantized embeddings (512->256 trial where acceptable), 2) Smart routing: route <100-token queries to emb-small; full-context to emb-large only when needed; 3) Rerank sampling: sample 10% of sessions for full-rerank and use cached top-K for UI. I'll put conservative %s on the slide.
Borealis Admin: Confirmed SmartSearch launched May 4. We'll pull logs and assign an engineer to the enablement. We'll also surface which user segments need real-time vs batch.
Priya (Onboarding PM): Invite sent for Tue 09:30 PT. Pre-meeting checklist in invite: top 500 queries, 2k sample calls, deploy diff link, and an architecture snippet for the search flow.
Lina (CSM): For the QBR slide let's include: 1) 30s incident summary + delta numbers, 2) plays with estimated savings & owners, 3) enablement plan & date, 4) asks (quota tweak, credit, follow-up cadence).
Mason (FinOps): Quick numbers draft for the deck: baseline monthly $12,600; projected if sustained $30,600; mitigated w/plays ~$18,900. I'll attach a short runway calc. Small snippet I used: ```
avg_daily = 420
spike_mult = 2.9
proj_month = avg_daily * spike_mult * 30
```
Gabe (Solutions Eng): Also suggest a short-term Dedicated trial for high-throughput campaign days (predictable per-token cost) as an option if they want steady latency + unit economics. We can propose a 2-week trial in the QBR as an ask.
Lina (CSM): Good call. Action items: Mason -> final 30d forecast + credit recommendation (EOD). Gabe -> plays slide + conservative savings (EOD). Priya -> ensure logs + run enablement Tue. I'll assemble the QBR slide and circulate tomorrow AM.
Borealis Admin: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll prioritize the sample export and confirm engineering attendees.
Lina (CSM): If we need immediate stop-gap during the campaign we can set route sampling or a temporary quota. Example: `POST /v1/accounts/borealis/quotas { "daily": 24000 }` or `PATCH /v1/accounts/borealis/routes/smart-search { "sample_rate": 0.2 }`. Will update when deck link is ready. :thumbsup:
Mason (FinOps): Final note  we'll flag renewal risk if monthly run-rate stays >2x baseline for 30d. Including sensitivity bands in the deck.
Lina (CSM): Thanks team, closing loop  will post deck link here once live. :pray:
